text.formatted: The scorpion makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.
text.plain: The scorpion makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
